# fp-ts-sandbox1 — Functional-Light TypeScript Library Suite

> Plain-object `Result` core with thin, framework-boundary-trap adapters. Everything is plain data: Results survive JSON, structuredClone, RSC payloads, "use cache" and tRPC transformers. Tagged errors are plain objects with a `_tag` and a structural `.is()` guard (no `instanceof`). Defects are thrown as `Panic` and sanitized at the edge. No HKTs, no Option. ESM-only, TypeScript ^7, erasable syntax, `isolatedDeclarations`-clean.

## Packages

- `@friday-friday/core` — Result (`{ ok: true, value } | { ok: false, error }`), tagged errors, pipe/flow, dual combinators (`map`, `andThen`, `orElse`, `tap`, `matchTag`, `all`), boundary triage (`try`/`tryAsync(fn, { catch, rethrow, signal })`), `toPanic` (the one idempotent defect conversion every lane uses). Subpaths: `/async` (`retry`, `timeout` -> Err(Timeout), `mapAsync`/`andThenAsync`/`orElseAsync`, `allAsync`, `mapConcurrent`), `/gen` (do-notation via `$()` + `gen`/`genAsync`), `/wire` (`sanitize`, `toProblem` RFC 9457 body, `fromWire` parse-back, `toDefect` fixed `InternalDefect` envelope, `PROBLEM_CONTENT_TYPE`; rules in docs/decisions/2026-11-17-core-wire-subpath.md).
- `@friday-friday/schema` — Standard Schema -> Result: `parse`/`parseAsync` -> `ValidationFailure` with structured issues, `toValidationFailure(issues)` (the one producer: each issue projected to `{ message, path }`), `toFieldErrors`/`toFormErrors`, phantom `branded`, `toJsonSchema`. Types-only vendoring of `@standard-schema/spec`.
- `@friday-friday/next` — Next.js adapter: sentinel-safe triage (`unstable_rethrow` first), `orNotFound`/`orRedirect`/`orForbidden` loaders, `toResponse(r, statuses?, { onDefect }?)` (problem+json built by core `/wire` `toProblem`; an unmapped tag is a 500 `InternalDefect`), `action()` (useActionState; validates with `parseAsync` inside the triage, so async schemas return `Err(ValidationFailure)`; repeated FormData keys become arrays, single keys stay scalars; defects return core `/wire`'s fixed-text `InternalDefect`, the original only to `onDefect`; redirect/`notFound` sentinels survive the triage, also through `mapAsync`). `/client` (imports `client-only`, so it throws under `react-server`): `orThrow(r)` + `resultBoundary(Fallback)` for errors a CLIENT component throws; a server-thrown error reaches the browser as `{ digest }` only (dev: name/message/stack), never its tagged data, so server domain errors cross as returned Results. Core `toThrowable` puts no `cause` on the Error (React dev would serialize it).
- `@friday-friday/query` — TanStack Query: `toQueryFn` (Err throws the tagged error so `query.error === E`; Ok(undefined) -> null; signal forwarded), `retryUnless`, `resultQueryOptions` (every `QueryObserverOptions` field passes through untouched; returns a `DataTag`-ged `queryKey` so `getQueryData`/`getQueryState(...).error` infer T and E; `queryFn: skipToken` passes through for conditional queries).
- `@friday-friday/better-auth` — Better Auth: `authCall` (server lane, structural `isAPIError`), `fromAuthTuple` (client lane), `requireSession`/`requireRole`, `beforeDbHook`. One `AuthError` vocabulary: `Unauthenticated | Forbidden | AuthApiError{status, code}`.
- `@friday-friday/http` — HTTP client: `fetchResult(url, { schema, signal, timeoutMs, retries })` -> `HttpError{status, problem?} | NetworkError | Timeout | ValidationFailure`; RFC 9457 parsing; `reconstruct()` round-trips tagged errors losslessly.
- `@friday-friday/otel` — OpenTelemetry spans: `traced`/`tracedSync` mark Err as ERROR + `friday_friday.error.tag` attribute WITHOUT recording exceptions (expected errors vs bugs separate in dashboards); defects recorded as exceptions.
- `@friday-friday/hono` — Hono server adapter: `respond(c, result, statuses)` keeps status-literal unions (hc client infers `res.status` as `200 | 404 | ...`), `problem()` RFC 9457, `sv()` Standard Schema validation (422 Problem), `onErrorHandler` (HTTPException passthrough with headers; sanitized 500 for defects).
- `@friday-friday/trpc` — tRPC v11 dual channel: `resultMiddleware` (Err -> TRPCError with mapped code, cause preserved), `errorFormatter` (`data.fl` = sanitized tagged error or ~standard issues), `resultProcedure` data-channel opt-in, `fromTRPC<T, E>` client reconstruction.
- `@friday-friday/tanstack-start` — Start/Router: `resultHandler` (validates INSIDE the handler — the #6428 workaround; ValidationFailure as structured data), rethrows Router redirect()/notFound() sentinels unwrapped, other throws become `Panic` via core `toPanic`; `loaderResult` (always a promise; rejects with Router's notFound()/redirect() sentinels unwrapped), `formErrorMap` passthrough.
- `@friday-friday/db` — DB error mappers: `mapPgError` (SQLSTATE 23505 -> Conflict, 23503 -> ForeignKeyViolation, 23502 -> NotNullViolation), `mapPrismaError` (P2002 -> Conflict, P2003 -> ForeignKeyViolation, P2025 -> NotFound), `mapDbError` (Prisma then PG). Structural reads up to 5 hops down `cause` (drizzle wrappers map), zero vendor imports; props carry schema names only, driver detail stays on server-only `cause`.
- `@friday-friday/env` — `parseEnv(schema, env?)`: Standard Schema over `process.env`/`import.meta.env`; ValidationFailure field errors built from the variable name only (`NAME is missing`/`NAME is invalid`, so no value or derived copy of a secret is echoed), blank values count as unset, no throw at import time. @t3-oss/env interop documented.
- `@friday-friday/eslint-plugin` — `must-use-result`, `no-try-around-redirect`, `no-instanceof-tagged-error` (enforced repo-wide).
- `examples/next-app` — profile update form end-to-end on Result (issue #9).

## Core conventions

- Errors: plain objects with `_tag`; structural `.is(u)`; factories: `taggedError("Tag")<Props>()`.
- Defects: thrown as `Panic(cause)`; adapters sanitize to `InternalDefect`/problem+json at edges.
- Boundary triage: `try`/`tryAsync(fn, { catch, rethrow, signal })` — `catch` maps unknown throws to domain errors; returning `undefined` = defect = rethrow as Panic; `rethrow` runs FIRST (framework sentinels are control flow).
- Signals flow DOWN: helpers take `{ signal }` and forward it into callbacks.
- Peers only, never bundled framework code; vendor libs appear as devDep fixtures only.
- Adapter size budget: <= 2 kB min+gz excluding peers.

- Commands: `pnpm run lint` (oxlint + local ESLint rules + dprint), `pnpm run check` (tsc; TS 6.0/7.1-beta matrix in CI), `pnpm test` (Vitest + type tests), `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run size`, `pnpm run ci` (every gate incl. smoke; not `pnpm ci`, which is pnpm 12's clean install)

## Status

Phases 1-4 complete (core, schema, next, examples, query, better-auth, http, otel, hono, trpc, tanstack-start, db, env). Phase 5 remainder: `effect` bridge, codemods, oRPC recipe. Nothing published to npm (private 0.x until Eric says so).
